default_rule: A workflow not explicitly listed as CURRENT or CURRENT_COMPATIBLE is not permitted in the live .github/workflows namespace.

live_workflows.purpose: One small stdlib-Python AIOC authority/registry/runtime health check. It validates AIOC only and does not require cross-repository token access.
